verdicts.reason: Both are letterboxed: the patterned background band stops roughly 85px from the top and bottom, leaving flat white bars so the image reads as a shrunk copy, not a resize, and the pattern's edges are hard-cropped. A keeps more of the triangle and squiggle art visible around a centred panel, and its gold keyline frame stays close to the original. B stretches the dark panel to about 73% of the width, which covers most of the brand pattern and leaves the headline floating in an oversized empty box.
